messages:
Maria Chen: OK kicking off a short thread to align on long-term routing + multi-region tenant isolation. Goal: pick launch criteria and what falls into Phase 1 vs later.
Alex Rivera: +1 — have a few customer asks that will shape priorities (fintech client needs strict region pinning & audit trails).
Chris Patel: Important to separate routing policy types: latency-driven vs cost-driven vs regulatory pinning. Each has different infra surface.
Samir Gupta: Agree. For Phase 1 proposal: 1) basic region affinity (soft), 2) tenant tagging and isolation labels, 3) routing fallback rules. Hard region pinning is Phase 2.
Alex Rivera: Customers keep asking for hard pinning though. What are the blockers for Phase 1 -> Phase 2?
Chris Patel: Blockers: affinity state store, cross-region KV consistency model, and rollout playbook for live migrations. Also cost impact on capacity planning.
Maria Chen: Launch criteria idea: measurable SLOs (p95 tail latency delta <= 15% for pinned requests), compliance checklist (KMS audit + logs), and migration tool for tenant move with <5m degradation window.
Samir Gupta: Can we get an estimate of infra work? Roughly: affinity store + control plane APIs (2 sprint), routing mesh changes (3 sprint), migration tooling (2 sprint), testing & canary (2 sprint). Total ~9 sprints.
Alex Rivera: That's helpful. We should prioritize features customers will pay for: hard pinning + audit logs as enterprise add-on. Soft affinity and fallback stay as default.
Chris Patel: Operational concerns: isolation lanes for noisy tenants, quota enforcement per lane, and SLA-based routing. Need to define preflight checks.
Maria Chen: Proposal: Phase 1 (Q2-Q3): soft affinity + fallback + tenant labels + basic audit logs. Phase 2 (Q4): hard region pinning, migration tooling, lane quotas, SLA routing.
Samir Gupta: Risk list: cross-region failover complexity, double-billing during migrations, cache-warmup latency spikes. Add to risk register.
Alex Rivera: Customer negotiation play: offer early access to dedicated customers for Phase 2 features with pilot pricing.
Chris Patel: For the RFC we should include: schema for routing policy, state machine for tenant migration, rollout gating metrics, and a compatibility matrix (models, quantizations, regions).
Maria Chen: I'll draft the RFC. Owner: Maria. Reviewers: Alex, Chris, Samir. Deadline: next Wed (thread_ts + 10d) — please review by then.
infra-bot: deployment-check: no blocking deploy issues found for config branch "routing-rfc-draft" :white_check_mark:
Alex Rivera: thanks — will add customer ask examples and SLA language to RFC.
Samir Gupta: I'll add operational runbooks and soft-eviction play.
Chris Patel: +1 to ship RFC early. Also request we add two gating metrics: migration success rate >= 99% and no production latency regressions > 10% for pinned traffic.
Maria Chen: noted. Filing RFC now and will paste link here when ready. :rocket:
